claims.statement: Vitest runs in a Node environment with the project setup file and includes integration and unit tests under tests/int and tests/unit.
Playwright uses the configured frontend URL, runs Chromium and Firefox projects, starts the development server locally or the production server in CI, and retries only in CI.
The integration API test initializes Payload, creates and verifies a category-product relationship, and deletes those created records in afterAll cleanup.
Frontend E2E tests verify a successful homepage response and title and check that several viewport widths do not overflow horizontally.
Admin E2E tests seed a user and post, exercise authenticated admin navigation, verify the public post editor link, and clean up the seeded records.
